author: CC
prose: Orchestrator, 2026-11-13, Group H of the Windows census: 45 proofs red with a backslash in the result. Re-running them with Path.write_text forced to LF turned four green: test_rung_4_follows_the_ticket_kind and the three clearance proofs (test_clearance.py and the two that run it). Cause: write_text writes CRLF on Windows, the system gitconfig has core.autocrlf=true, git commits an LF blob, and rung4 reads the bounded bytes back from git by sha256 and finds none.
